item.title: Sen. Chris Murphy had a stroke and is in the hospital, his office says
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy's office says the Connecticut Democrat is in the hospital after having a stroke. His chief of staff says in a statement that Murphy experienced numbness in his arm while at his son’s hockey game Saturday.

item.title: Sudan’s power grid nears collapse as drone strikes blamed on RSF target electric stations
item.description: Drone strikes have knocked out power substations in the northern Sudanese towns of Al-Dabbah and Abu Hamad.

item.title: Most suspects released after Israeli court says no evidence for accusation of bribery in election
item.description: Israeli police have released two of three suspects in an alleged voter bribery case. The releases on Sunday seem to weaken accusations by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his Likud party that Arab-led parties stole last week’s parliamentary election.
